verdict.rationale: Circle's Wallets API lets developers programmatically create a wallet per user (circle-docs-14/15) and webhooks notify on state changes (circle-docs-10), which could support per-customer deposit addresses and event-driven reconciliation, but no evidence explicitly documents named virtual accounts or a dedicated-deposit-address/reconciliation feature tying incoming funds to a specific customer without manual matching. missing for 10: explicit 'per-customer deposit address' or 'virtual account' documentation, explicit reconciliation/matching feature description, any hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
